{{Quote|When ''From a Certain Point of View'' came up they asked who I'd like to write about in ''A New Hope''. I told them Qui-Gon! Though he wasn't in the film, of course, I said I could show them how it might work. Though I didn't anticipate writing a novel at that time, I had been saying to Lucasfilm Publishing that I would love to write about Qui-Gon in case there was ever a chance. I did not expect this book-length story to come along so quickly.|Claudia Gray|<ref name="Interview">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-master-apprentice-claudia-gray-interview|text=''Star Wars: Master & Apprentice'': A Peek Inside with Author Claudia Gray}}</ref>}}
'''''Master & Apprentice''''' is a [[canon]] novel written by [[Claudia Gray]] which was published by [[Del Rey]] on [[April 16]], [[2019]]. The novel is set approximately eight [[Standard year|years]] prior to the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], following [[Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan]] apprentice, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. The [[Master & Apprentice (audiobook)|audiobook version]] was narrated by [[Jonathan Davis]].
